ui.settings.privacy.title: Privacy
ui.settings.privacy.description: What Local Operator may share about how it is used. Nothing is shared unless you turn it on.
ui.settings.privacy.usage_explanation: Only used to count how many people actively use Local Operator. Full privacy stays on: no conversations, prompts, files or session details are ever collected, stored or used. You can turn this off at any time.
ui.settings.privacy.save_failed: Could not save your privacy choice. Nothing changed.
ui.settings.privacy.launch_off: Usage statistics are switched off for this launch, so nothing is sent regardless of this setting.
